title: Farmers Resist Excessive Fertilizer Use
reason: The transcript discusses farmers' methods and reasons for using less fertilizer, showcasing changes in agricultural practices.

tasks.task: Explain the reasons and methods farmers in Canada use to reduce fertilizer usage.

subtasks.text: Farmers in Canada state they have economic reasons for using minimal fertilizer due to its cost.
They utilize satellite maps to target fertilizer application precisely.
There has been a significant reduction in fertilizer use over the last 40 years.

tasks.task: Highlight the increased agricultural productivity despite reduced fertilizer use.

subtasks.text: Farmers have been able to produce more food with less fertilizer.
The reduction in fertilizer use has resulted in less strain on resources.
